sonicScene.thesis: The Tidewriter, illustrated: an anime-background ocean world at sunset -- a low island of cut-paper palms, a sport motor yacht cruising past with its wake, dolphins leaping across the sun's path, painted cumulus banks and drifting sun rays. Colour is the instrument: the music moves the whole world between violet sunset, golden afternoon and electric blue, while the bass writes its history into the swell.

composition.background: a violet-to-coral sky, painted cumulus banks in two drifting layers, sun rays, far island strips
composition.midground: a low island strip with five cut-paper trees and a broken surf line on the left third; the yacht crossing in front
composition.foreground: anime water: soft colour bands drawn by the swell's height and faces, thin crest strokes, foam caps on the reinforced crests, the sun's path broken into horizontal sparks
composition.focal: the low sun with its rays on the right third and its column of glints
secondary: the motor yacht and its V-wake
composition.atmosphere: distance haze on land and clouds; the far sea flattens into colour and glitter
composition.post: a little bloom on the sun and the glints
composition.camera: still: 14 m over the water, 32 mm, the horizon at ~44 % from the top

palette.background_value: mid (a coral horizon under a violet sky)
palette.saturation: three coordinated palettes on one axis (violet sunset, golden afternoon, electric blue) plus a bioluminescent night end

very_slow: the cloud banks turning round the viewer (two layers, parallax)
medium: three Gerstner trains (their pace and dominant direction on controls)

vocabulary: PALETTE: a build moves the world toward golden afternoon and electric blue; a breakdown sinks it back to the violet sunset; the water's bands tighten
TIDEWRITING: the bass's last ~15 s roll in as swell; the water's body deepens and the crest light lifts
a lifted front rolls in; crest light, foam and the sun rays flash
the swell grows and quickens (an integrated phase: no crest jumps), the rays strengthen (slowly)
the rays reach further for a moment
glints and crest strokes flare; mint enters the lit faces
the sky's middle turns pink, the clouds' lit undersides warm, the halo swells
a slight warm or cool drift of the whole grade
sparks on the sun's path, by pitch and velocity
PALETTE: violet sunset -> golden afternoon -> electric blue
WAVE ENERGY: chop, foam and the tide's depth
SUN RAYS: strength, reach, halo and the sun's path
CLOUDS: the glow on the clouds
WATER COLOUR: the richness of the water
SPRAY: drums' spray and notes' sparks
WAVE SPEED: the authored pace to 2.5x, without a crest jumping
WAVE DIRECTION: the cross swell gives way to the wind sea
BAND CONTRAST: soft painted bands to crisp cel shading
HIGHLIGHTS: the crest strokes brighten and widen
FOAM: more and brighter foam caps
SURFACE DETAIL: streaks across the bands
LEAP: a dolphin arcs across the sun's path
HERO WAVE: a big swell rises far out and rolls in, foaming
FLARE: the sun and its rays blaze and settle
DAYBREAK: the world sweeps to electric day and back to the sunset
the swell rolls, clouds and rays drift, the yacht crosses every ~75 s, pods leap every 53 and 79 s
sonicScene.tier: light: an anime-water sea (three meshes, eight deformers each, a 47-op program near and 39 far), seven unlit programs, an island strip, five trees, a yacht and its masked wake, ~320 cloud puffs, fixed particle pools; no lights, no shadows, no fog march
sonicScene.title: Digital Ocean
